Class StripeService.GetStripeBalanceTransactions

public class StripeService.GetStripeBalanceTransactions
implements Queueable

Queueable class that retrieves detailed balance transaction information from the Stripe API for processed transactions. Makes callouts to Stripe's API to fetch balance transaction data, maps the response to StripeTransaction__c fields using FieldMappingEngine, and updates the records in Salesforce. Implements governor limit protection for callouts and execution time, and chains itself for additional batches if needed.

Methods

public void execute(QueueableContext qc)

Executes the queueable job to retrieve balance transaction data from Stripe API. Processes transactions in batches, making API callouts for each transaction that requires balance transaction retrieval. Maps the API response data to Salesforce fields and updates records. Implements safeguards for callout limits and execution time, and chains itself for remaining batches if needed.

Parameters:
    qc – QueueableContext: The context in which the job is executed
